thread:
marco_support: heads up @anya_csm — NexaWorks (enterprise trial) is stuck in activation. customer reports SSO flow redirects to a blank page and their embed widget returns 403 intermittently. flagged as renewal risk if not resolved by EOW.
anya_csm: thanks marco. can you paste the error logs and the last repro steps here? i want to assess impact and coordinate an enablement session.
marco_support: repro steps: 1) user clicks SSO from app 2) redirect to our auth callback 3) blank page. embed error shows in console: 
```
fetch("https://api.redwood.ai/embed/v1", {status: 403})
Error: Forbidden - token scope missing
```
also noticed spikes in 429s around 2026-03-18 14:02 UTC.
jordan_se: likely a token scope mismatch combined with the new CSP header we've rolled out last week. putting quick checks in place, but we need CS to own comms and a guided unblock with the customer.
anya_csm: agree. this is starting to show as a renewal sentiment change — they pinged success sponsor saying onboarding "fell apart". propose: 1) 30m customer coaching + SSO troubleshooting call tomorrow 2) temporary bypass to allow embed while we patch CSP mapping 3) capture feedback to product on auth docs. can megan lead the call? @megan_csm?
megan_csm: can do. i'm available tomorrow 13:00-15:00 PT. i'll run through a checklist: SSO metadata, redirect URIs, token scopes, and embed config. will record the session and share notes.
marco_support: i've prepped a minimal config snippet they should try. sharing here for the call: 
```
redirect_uri: https://app.nexaworks.com/auth/callback
client_scopes: ["openid","profile","embed:read","embed:write"]
csp: "frame-src 'self' https://embed.redwood.ai"
```
if we allow embed:read temporarily it unblocks the admin flow.
ops_bot: Incident created: INC-2026-3317 assigned to eng-runtime. priority: P2. ETA for patch: 24-48h.
anya_csm: action items: marco to enable temporary scope bypass for NexaWorks (until patch), megan to schedule and run call, jordan to prepare a short patch plan and fallback instructions, i'll draft the renewal comms note for execs. please update this thread when done.
jordan_se: will post patch plan by EOD. likely config mapping change + small rollout, no infra changes.
marco_support: temporary bypass enabled for customer id nxw-889. noted expiry: 48h. monitoring metrics for 403/429 now.
megan_csm: scheduled 2026-03-19 14:00 UTC. invite sent to NexaWorks + internal: anya_csm, marco_support, jordan_se. agenda: repro, config checklist, temporary bypass confirmation, next steps.
anya_csm: thanks team. i'll prepare the renewal note and include customer sentiment and next steps. please capture any product feedback during the call in this thread so i can attach to the renewal playbook. :thumbsup:
marco_support: saw 60% drop in 403s after bypass. will keep watching and post metrics at +2h.
ops_bot: Update: INC-2026-3317 status changed to in_progress.
megan_csm: post-call: SSO completed, embed works for admin users, recorded steps + config attached to the event page. customer asked for clearer docs on token scopes and a sample embed policy.
anya_csm: excellent. next: jordan — please confirm patch ETA and whether we should extend bypass window. also i'll send an exec-facing summary for CSM leadership.
jordan_se: patch ETA confirmed 36h. recommend extend bypass to 72h to cover rollout and validation. will coordinate a canary then full rollout.
marco_support: extended bypass to 72h for nxw-889. monitoring alert thresholds lowered to detect regressions.
anya_csm: closing loop: renewal risk downgraded to watch. capturing customer asks: clearer token scope docs, example CSP for embeds, and a short troubleshooting checklist. i will submit the feedback ticket to product. thanks everyone. :clap:
